question.text:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I : Hyperconjugation is not a permanent effect.
Statement II : In general, greater the number of alkyl groups attached to a positively charged C -atom, greater is the hyperconjugation interaction and stabilization of the cation.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below

options.text: Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Both Statement I and Statement II are true

solution.text: Hyper conjugation is permanent effect because external reagent is not required, so Statement-I is false and Statement-II is true. because moore alkyl group, more $\alpha-H$, so more hyperconjugation which results more stability of carbocation.
